full_page.content:
1950, February 11 March 8
Sister Mary Constance
Page 3
March 8th
Dear Sister Mary Constance God bless you I want to catch mailman. Please God you 11 here from me shortly - suppliment to the above
God bless you Sister:
Your pathetic letter of a month ago has been on my mind ever since, as your vocation, has been increasingly in my prayers: seeing your intricate problems, your growing embarrassments, your so fearfully threatening dangers to temporal welfare as well as to the (spiritual) - and sadest of all your seemingly unsuspecting blindness, till thanks be to God! your very last, but redeeming paragraph
(Unfinished draft)
